LanguageData.FCP_LostHills_Enlist_Letter_Label:
Initiate, this is a message from the Elder's office. You have passed your trials and been accepted into the Western Chapter - the founding order, keepers of the true Codex. We do not extend this honor lightly.

You will be issued a standard salary every week for you and your team, along with provisions that can be collected at our bunkers when you are not on patrol or recovering lost technology. Lost Hills maintains some of the most advanced facilities in the wasteland - use them wisely, and do not disgrace the bloodline.

 -Ad Victoriam
LanguageData.FCP_LostHills_Enlist_Button_Desc: Sign a new contract with the {FACTION_name}.
LanguageData.FCP_LostHills_Enlist_Requrements_Not_Sat: You need a minimum of 10 goodwill, currently you have only {0} goodwill.
LanguageData.FCP_LostHills_Menu_Missions_Desc: While leaving the bunker you ask around about any potential tasks that need doing.
LanguageData.FCP_LostHills_Salary_Desc: You are entitled to collect wages from this faction every 14 days.
LanguageData.FCP_LostHills_Provisions_Desc: Provisions will arrive via your caravan inventory every 10 days:\n\n- ×6 BoS Food Crate
LanguageData.FCP_LostHills_Provisions_Desc_Standard_I:
Western Chapter standard issue gear will arrive via your caravan inventory every 45 days:

- ×2 BoS Weapon Crate
- ×2 BoS Tech Resource Crate
- ×2 BoS Uniform Crate
LanguageData.FCP_LostHills_Storage_Desc: Store items from your caravan to your faction stash. Faction stashes transfer across all of the faction's outposts and will save contents even if you are no longer enlisted.
LanguageData.FCP_LostHills_Part_Time_Job_Desc: Pull additional duties and cover for your Paladin and Scribe brothers for $10 an hour.
LanguageData.FCP_LostHills_Hospital_Desc: Check in with the bunker's hospital. This service tends to all of your team with industrial medicine. Immunity gain is also increased while your team is in the hospital.
LanguageData.FCP_LostHills_Paladin_Training_Desc:
Train under the Western Chapter's elite drill instructors, with hourly experience gain on the following skills:

- Shooting, Melee

Hourly experience gain stops when this faction is resting at night.
LanguageData.FCP_LostHills_Scribe_Training_Desc:
Train among the keepers of the original Codex, with hourly experience gain on the following skills:

- Crafting
- Intellectual
- Medicine

Hourly experience gain stops when this faction is resting at night.
LanguageData.FCP_LostHills_Turn_In_Desc: Turn in war prisoners and high value targets to Western Chapter facilities.\n\n -Turning over any hostile pawns do not result in a slavery debuff-
LanguageData.FCP_LostHills_Resign_Menu_Text: You will resign from the {FACTION_name} effective immediately. (-25 in relations)
LanguageData.FCP_LostHills_Resign_Button_Label: You have successfully resigned from the {FACTION_name}. (-25 relations)
LanguageData.FCP_LostHills_Enlisted_To_Hostile_Factio: cannot join because you are enlisted with their enemy, {HOSTILEFACTION_name}
LanguageData.FCP_LostHills_Kick_Out_Label_Title: An order for your contract's immediate termination from service has been filed by {LEADER_nameDef}. You have been kicked out from the {FACTION_name}.
LanguageData.FCP_LostHills_Reinforcements_Button_Desc: Call for reinforcements from your faction. The number of Paladins and Scribes they send depends on your current relations.
